title: Goldspotted Rabbitfish anatomy and virtual dissection
subtitle: Goldspotted Rabbitfish
description: A guided draft activity covering safe orientation, external morphology, morphometric observation, gill inspection, virtual incision, organ identification, and observation documentation.
learningGoals: Recognize venom-bearing fin spines and apply the safety notice
Identify gills and major internal organs in their expected regions
Document observations without overstating specimen-specific conclusions

steps.title: Meet the Goldspotted Rabbitfish
steps.description: Begin with the locally authored side-view swimming reference, then compare the natural, external-anatomy, and internal-anatomy illustration layers. These educational visuals are awaiting faculty review and may not represent every individual variation.
steps.prompt: Observe the tail movement, fin position, body motion, and surrounding water and bubbles, then switch to the 2.5D anatomy view and compare the body outline.

steps.title: Recognize venom-bearing spines
steps.description: Rabbitfish dorsal, pelvic, and anal fin spines can deliver venom and cause a painful puncture. Physical handling requires trained supervision and an approved laboratory safety protocol.
steps.prompt: Locate the dorsal, pelvic, and anal fins without touching a real specimen.

steps.title: Inspect external morphology
steps.description: External landmarks support species description, orientation, locomotion, feeding, and sensory interpretation.
steps.prompt: Find the eye, mouth, operculum, lateral line, and caudal fin.

steps.title: Make morphometric observations
steps.description: On a real specimen, total length, standard length, body depth, and mass are recorded with calibrated tools. This virtual activity demonstrates the landmarks only.
steps.prompt: Use the mouth, caudal fin base, and body outline as measurement landmarks, then continue.

steps.title: Inspect the gills
steps.description: The operculum covers delicate gill arches and filaments used for gas exchange.
steps.prompt: Select the gills and connect their position with the operculum.

steps.title: Trace a supervised incision path
steps.description: The simulation uses the vent as an orientation landmark and avoids every fin spine. It does not authorize an unsupervised physical dissection.
steps.prompt: Select the vent, then trace the virtual incision path.

steps.title: Open the body cavity virtually
steps.description: Observe organs in place before moving or identifying them. Note their relative position, color, shape, and connections.
steps.prompt: Open the virtual body wall to reveal the cavity.

steps.title: Identify the major organs
steps.description: Use relative position as one clue and avoid assuming that every specimen looks identical.
steps.prompt: Find the heart, liver, gallbladder, stomach, intestine, and swim bladder.

steps.title: Document what you observed
steps.description: A useful record separates direct observations from interpretations and notes any uncertainty or specimen variation.
steps.prompt: Review the kidney, gonad, spleen, and vertebral column, then prepare an observation note.

steps.title: Check your understanding
steps.description: Complete this formative knowledge check. It is not a high-stakes assessment.
steps.prompt: Choose one answer for each question.
